definitions.explanation: The process of becoming different; a transformation in state, form, or condition.

examples.japanese: {季節|きせつ}の{変化|へんか}を{楽|たの}しむ。
examples.english: To enjoy the change of seasons.

examples.japanese: {状況|じょうきょう}が{大|おお}きく{変化|へんか}した。
{気候|きこう}{変動|へんどう}による{変化|へんか}が{心配|しんぱい}だ。
examples.english: I'm worried about changes due to climate change.

notes:
USAGE: {変化|へんか} is a general word for change and can be used in many contexts.

COMMON PATTERNS:
・{変化|へんか}する (to change)
・{変化|へんか}が{起|お}きる (change occurs)
・{変化|へんか}を{遂|と}げる (to undergo change)
・{大|おお}きな/{小|ちい}さな{変化|へんか} (big/small change)
・{変化|へんか}に{富|と}む (rich in variety)

SIMILAR WORDS:
・{変更|へんこう} - change, modification (deliberate alteration)
・{変動|へんどう} - fluctuation (repeated changes)
・{変容|へんよう} - transformation (fundamental change)
